description: Change-intent summaries specified before the rerun; not assertions about defects.

intents.side-effect-failure-positive: Generate a thumbnail after saving a document.
intents.llm-usage-positive: Use a second provider when the first returns a retryable result.
intents.cancellation-positive: Start a polling worker for the duration of a request.
intents.terminal-state-positive: Update a job status when progress is published.
intents.critical-section-positive: Change how inventory reservations use a lock.
intents.delivery-positive: Process invoice messages and initiate bank transfers.
intents.frontend-race-positive: Change the metrics query key for a workspace dashboard.
intents.frontend-cost-positive: Change how the results page loads its records.
intents.stream-disconnect-positive: Stop processing the provider stream when the client disconnects.
intents.lock-order-positive: Acquire an account lock inside the transfer operation.
intents.outbox-atomicity-positive: Write a shipment and create its dispatch record.
intents.optional-timeout-positive: Load recommendations before returning a profile.
intents.state-version-positive: Save profile enrichment after remote lookup.
intents.loading-race-positive: Clear the loading indicator when data fetching ends.
intents.waterfall-positive: Load the address and payment options for checkout.
